content: Hello, this is Amazon Security calling. May I speak with Mr. Harris, please?
Yes, this is Robert Harris. Is there a problem with my account?

Thank you for confirming, Mr. Harris. We noticed suspicious activity on your Amazon account, and as a precaution, the system has frozen your recent funds to protect you. I want to assure you, we are here to help resolve this as quickly as possible.
Oh, I see. I haven't noticed anything myself. What exactly happened?

We detected an unusual login attempt from a new device. It's standard for Amazon to temporarily freeze funds in such cases. With your cooperation, we can verify your identity and safely release the hold.
Alright, what do you need me to do?
First, for your security, may I confirm your full date of birth and the email address registered to your Amazon account?
Sure, my birthday is May 17th, 1970, and my email is rharris52@gmail.com.

Thank you for that information. Now, to proceed, I need to validate the last four digits of your primary payment card on file. This is a security measure to ensure we are speaking with the rightful owner.
Okay, it's 2194.
Perfect, thank you. You're cooperating wonderfully, Mr. Harris. The next step is to authenticate your Amazon wallet. I'll guide you through a standard verification process, it's quick and safe.
Alright, just tell me what to do.
Please log in to your Amazon account and confirm if you see any notifications about a fund hold or unusual activity.
Yes, I see a message about funds being temporarily held.
That is expected. Now, to unlock the funds, our secure process requires a quick verification transfer. It helps confirm you are in control of the account and not an unauthorized user.
What kind of transfer?
We use secure payment methods such as Zelle, wire transfer, or crypto wallet to complete this verification. Do you have a preferred method, or would you like me to recommend the quickest option?
I'm familiar with Zelle. Is that alright?
Absolutely, Zelle is fast and secure. I will provide you with an Amazon verification account to send the funds. The amount is $2,000, which will be instantly refunded once the process is complete.
Do I need to send it now?
Yes, please. While you prepare, I want to reassure you this is a standard process for account security. Your funds will remain safe, and our team is here throughout.
Okay. What's the Zelle address?
Please send the amount to support.amazon.verify@gmail.com. Once you've sent it, let me know so I can confirm the verification in our system.
Alright, I'm getting my phone ready.
Take your time, Mr. Harris. If you have any questions during the process, I'm right here to assist you.
Is this really necessary? I've never done this before.
I completely understand your concern. We only request this for your protection, to ensure no unauthorized persons have access. Many customers have completed this quickly and safely.
Alright, I'm about to send it. Is there anything else you need?
Once the transfer is complete, I'll ask for a screenshot of the confirmation, just so we can expedite the unfreezing of your funds. You can email it to our secure address.
Okay, I will do that as soon as it goes through.
Thank you, Mr. Harris. You're doing the right thing to keep your account secure. Please let me know once you've sent the payment.
